explicit_validation.explanation: Paper explicitly compares GPT-4o annotations against human judgments on the same set of 400 BFI responses and reports correlation analysis

prompts.notes: Full prompt provided in Table 8 showing exact system and user prompts used for BFI scoring

inter_annotator_agreement.notes: Pearson correlation coefficient reported for human inter-rater agreement

guidelines.notes: Pre-annotation workshop with calibrated trait understanding, structured explanations of Big Five framework, detailed trait dimension definitions provided

sample_size.notes: 400 GPT-annotated responses were used for validation comparison between GPT-4o and human judgments

quantitative_scores.notes: Strong correlation between GPT annotations and human judgments

validation_results.summary_finding: GPT-4o annotations show strong correlation (r=0.92) with human judgments on BFI personality scoring, supporting the reliability of GPT-based personality assessment.

criteria_mapping.notes: Both LLM and human evaluated the same BFI personality scoring criterion on the same set of instances
